explanation_of_variance.value: The Meridian Refurbishment Allowance of $468,950 was coded as an abatement in 2020.
explanation_of_variance.citation: [Page 1] The Meridian Refurbishment Allowance of $468,950 was coded as an abatement in 2020.

explanation_of_variance.value: Starting in April 2020 monthly parking accounts were put on hold due to the pandemic and tenants working from home. The garage operated at less then 20% of normal activity. To mitigate the losses, the garage has only 1 attendant (versus 3 attendants) for the rest of 2020. In 2021 we are assuming only 1 attendant as well. The projections for 2021 are assuming the first quarter is at the 2020 level then it ramps up to about 80% of 2020 budget by the end of 2021.
explanation_of_variance.citation: [Page 1] Starting in April 2020 monthly parking accounts were put on hold due to the pandemic and tenants working from home. The garage operated at less then 20% of normal activity. To mitigate the losses, the garage has only 1 attendant (versus 3 attendants) for the rest of 2020. In 2021 we are assuming only 1 attendant as well. The projections for 2021 are assuming the first quarter is at the 2020 level then it ramps up to about 80% of 2020 budget by the end of 2021.

explanation_of_variance.value: Due to the pandemic and low tenant population in the building, tenant services requests and reimbursements are much less in 2020 compared to budget.
explanation_of_variance.citation: [Page 1] Due to the pandemic and low tenant population in the building, tenant services requests and reimbursements are much less in 2020 compared to budget.

explanation_of_variance.value: Lower interest income in 2020. No interest income budgeted in 2021 due to low interest rates.
explanation_of_variance.citation: [Page 2] Lower interest income in 2020. No interest income budgeted in 2021 due to low interest rates.

explanation_of_variance.value: Supervisory fee income charged in 2020 on Brightpath Group's out-of-pocket tenant improvement project. This income is not projected to continue in 2021.
explanation_of_variance.citation: [Page 2] Supervisory fee income charged in 2020 on Brightpath Group's out-of-pocket tenant improvement project. This income is not projected to continue in 2021.

explanation_of_variance.value: Lower occupancy in 2021. The 2021 budget assumes a $138,000 credit back to tenants for the 2020 reconciliations.
explanation_of_variance.citation: [Page 2] Lower occupancy in 2021. The 2021 budget assumes a $138,000 credit back to tenants for the 2020 reconciliations.

explanation_of_variance.value: The 2021 budget assumes an additonal $204,000 recovered from 2020 reconciliations.
explanation_of_variance.citation: [Page 2] The 2021 budget assumes an additonal $204,000 recovered from 2020 reconciliations.

explanation_of_variance.value: Summit Wireless (not previously budgeted in 2020) and Harbor Trade Council impact positively both the 2020 reforcast and the 2021 budget.
explanation_of_variance.citation: [Page 2] Summit Wireless (not previously budgeted in 2020) and Harbor Trade Council impact positively both the 2020 reforcast and the 2021 budget.

explanation_of_variance.value: COVID 19 supplies needed in 2021. The 2021 budget assumes a gradual expense increase starting from the 2020 numbers that are much lower since the tenant population was low and then ramping up to normalized tenant population numbers. In 2020 we had one time expenses such as dispensers, signage, safety items.

explanation_of_variance.value: Higher vacancy credit in 2020 due to lower building population caused by the pandemic. Higher costs in 2021 since special cleaning protocols are necessary to address Covid-19 and increased tenant population.
explanation_of_variance.citation: [Page 3] Higher vacancy credit in 2020 due to lower building population caused by the pandemic. Higher costs in 2021 since special cleaning protocols are necessary to address Covid-19 and increased tenant population.

explanation_of_variance.citation: [Page 3] Anchor certification is now an annual expense. Exterior window cleaning is budgeted to take place twice/year starting in 2021.

explanation_of_variance.value: Due to the pandemic the scavenger cost decreased significantly in 2020 (approximatelly 15% of building population). Annual costs are expected to gradually rise in 2021 as tenants return to the work place.

explanation_of_variance.value: New contract budgeted to commence on May 1, 2020 results in lower monthly maintenance fees. Contract price is increased by 3% on anniversary date.
explanation_of_variance.citation: [Page 4] New contract budgeted to commence on May 1, 2020 results in lower monthly maintenance fees. Contract price is increased by 3% on anniversary date.

explanation_of_variance.value: Plumbing, lights, HVAC supplies needed for frequent replacements due to the age of the existing equipment. Purchase gantry for $5,000 in 2021.
explanation_of_variance.citation: [Page 5] Plumbing, lights, HVAC supplies needed for frequent replacements due to the age of the existing equipment. Purchase gantry for $5,000 in 2021.

explanation_of_variance.value: Variance between 2020 budget and 2021 budget is caused by the following expenses: virtual fire drill, Datawatch monthly monitoring, radio and camera replacement. In the 2020 reforcast the numbers are high due to the one-time Datawatch installation that involved converting the video system to a digital platform, electrical work needed for the new system to become operational, installation of a gate in stairwell #2 and Otis cost to integrate the system. Ownership also approved the installation of the no-touch phase 1 system of Datawatch that involved Otis cost (labor and boards) and Datawatch expense.

explanation_of_variance.value: Increased rodent control and roof top spider control.
explanation_of_variance.citation: [Page 5] Increased rodent control and roof top spider control.

explanation_of_variance.value: The 2020 refocast number has $75k to replace the lobby pipe, $40k for boiler #4 repair and $7500 for Wellnest building certification. These are costs that were not budgeted. In 2021 the budget assumes masonery and dampers replacement at $25k each project, Elara master plan $12,500 and $35k for basement clean up from leaks (make safe) in addition to other recurring expenses.
